class.name: HTMLTableSectionElement
class.brief_description: A row group in an HTML table.
class.description: Represents the table head, a table body, or the table foot. Row operations address immediate child rows.

method.name: delete_row
method.description: Detaches the row at the given index and preserves its handle. Pass [code]-1[/code] to detach the last row. Returns [constant OK] if the list is empty and the index is [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_rows
method.description: Returns a snapshot of the rows.

method.name: insert_row
method.description: Inserts a row at the given index. Pass [code]-1[/code] to append. Returns [code]null[/code] for an invalid index.
